confirmation.rule: shadow rows logged after the candidate freeze timestamp, evaluated once

progress.note: ETA extrapolates settled games per day since the candidate freeze; null until a settled game exists.

soccer.dataset: shadow rows logged after the candidate freeze timestamp, evaluated once

diagnosis.verdict: over-confident at the extremes (slope < 1, low bucket realised above its prediction, high bucket below), with the home side under-estimated in the mid-range (positive intercept)

cells.why: exact cell n=10 and (minute,diff) n=10 both < minCell=30; local neighbour pool over goal difference used
exact cell n=23 and (minute,diff) n=23 both < minCell=30; local neighbour pool over goal difference used

levelLegend.2: LOCAL distance-weighted neighbour pool over goal difference (|k-d| <= 1, kernel 2^-|k-d|)

vsProduction.recommendation: The logistic matches or beats the production model on the fresh holdout. Recommend simplifying to the logistic.

firstCheckpoint.verdict: First-checkpoint predictions are close to the uninformed home base rate (no outcome information has entered the state yet).

truncation.verdict: The output at a checkpoint is IDENTICAL when every later event is removed from the input; the sensitivity probe shows a genuine later event DOES move it — so no future state is read.

leakage.verdict: Shuffling the game-level labels destroys the metric (it returns to the no-skill level): the low error therefore DEPENDS on the true outcome. This is a LABEL-DEPENDENCE test only — it does NOT by itself prove that no leakage is present. Leakage is ruled out directly by the first-checkpoint base-rate check and the post-checkpoint truncation test.
leakage.wording: Label dependence ≠ absence of leakage. This shows the metric needs the true labels; it is silent on whether the model reads future state.

basketball_logistic.label: Basketball home-win logistic — x = margin / sqrt(minutes remaining), per-league periods
basketball_logistic.overtime: OT checkpoint uses only the current OT period clock

soccer_table.label: Soccer empirical table P(home/draw/away | minute, capped diff, red)
soccer_table.model: empirical P(home/draw/away | minute, capped diff, red); LOCAL neighbour pool (|k-d|<=1) for thin cells; monotone fit on direct cells (level 0-1) with local-slope extension for fallbacks

soccer_score_time.label: Soccer score-and-time baseline (plain Poisson at global rates) — the release reference
soccer_score_time.model: scoreTime three-way (Phase 8/9 plain Poisson at global rates)

registration.rule: The release decision reads the PRIMARY candidate ONLY, versus scoreTime, with game-level CIs. Secondary candidates are logged but NOT selected on the confirmation data.
